cards.t: Thailand Sets October 16 Start for Local Crypto ETFs
cards.b: Thailand's new crypto rules take effect on October 16, allowing local mutual funds and asset managers to launch and invest in locally listed Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs.

per.BTC: Local spot ETFs authorized to begin trading on October 16 in Thailand.
per.ETH: Included alongside Bitcoin for local Thai asset manager ETF launches.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Specific names of the first asset managers issuing the local ETFs.

cards.t: Sui Launches Hashi Bitcoin Lending Protocol
cards.b: Layer-1 blockchain Sui is debuting Hashi, an institutional lending protocol backed by $500 million in commitments that allows holders to use Bitcoin as collateral without moving it off the Bitcoin network.

per.SUI: Launching Hashi protocol with $500M in commitments for Bitcoin lending.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact rollout date and full list of participating institutional partners.

cards.b: Solana is nearing the final stage of a seven-week push to halve its block times down to 200 milliseconds, increasing transaction frequency.

per.SOL: Finalizing upgrade to halve block times to 200 milliseconds.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Precise activation time and timestamp for the final block time change.

cards.b: The XRP Ledger released an emergency software patch to fix a decade-old bug that could have allowed transactions to create spendable XRP without proper funding from the sender.

per.XRP: Emergency patch fixes vulnerability that could create unauthorized tokens.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact date of vulnerability discovery and details on exploitation attempts.

cards.t: Tron Quantum-Resistant Cryptography Ready for Mainnet
cards.b: Tron founder Justin Sun announced that post-quantum cryptography has successfully gone live on the testnet and is ready for mainnet deployment.

per.TRX: Post-quantum cryptography tested and prepared for mainnet rollout.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact deployment date for the mainnet upgrade.

cards.b: Bitwise is winding down and liquidating its Dogecoin ETF (BWOW) on October 14.

per.DOGE: ETF product BWOW scheduled for liquidation by Bitwise on October 14.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Total remaining assets under management at the time of liquidation.
